LanguageData.Grechka_QuartzCable.label: underground quartz cable
LanguageData.Grechka_QuartzCable.description: Connects devices to the Storage controller underground. Cannot be damaged or burned and is normally hidden. Can run under buildings and ordinary power conduits. Does not transmit electricity. Signal lines appear when selecting the network or its construction tool.
LanguageData.Grechka_StorageController.label: Storage controller
LanguageData.Grechka_StorageController.description: An access point for the quartz signal network. Shows connected devices and their status. Multiple controllers on one network provide the same access. Consumes 400 W. Signal cable does not replace a power connection.
LanguageData.Grechka_Inscriber.label: electric inscriber
LanguageData.Grechka_Inscriber.description: Prints silicon elements and quartz, silver and gold circuits, and assembles processors. All recipes are available without presses. Requires 200 W.
LanguageData.Grechka_Quartz.label: quartz
LanguageData.Grechka_Quartz.description: Crystals from quartz veins. Used in signal cables and silicon parts.
LanguageData.Grechka_QuartzDust.label: quartz dust
LanguageData.Grechka_QuartzDust.description: Ground quartz for refining silicon in an electric smelter.
LanguageData.Grechka_Silicon.label: silicon
LanguageData.Grechka_Silicon.description: A prepared semiconductor for silicon wafers.
LanguageData.Grechka_SiliconSubstrate.label: silicon wafer
LanguageData.Grechka_SiliconSubstrate.description: A wafer for printed circuits and silicon processor parts.
LanguageData.Grechka_PrintedSilicon.label: printed silicon element
LanguageData.Grechka_PrintedSilicon.description: A common part for quartz, silver and gold processors.
LanguageData.Grechka_QuartzCircuit.label: printed quartz circuit
LanguageData.Grechka_QuartzCircuit.description: A quartz circuit for processor assembly.
LanguageData.Grechka_SilverCircuit.label: printed silver circuit
LanguageData.Grechka_SilverCircuit.description: A silver circuit for processor assembly.
LanguageData.Grechka_GoldCircuit.label: printed gold circuit
LanguageData.Grechka_GoldCircuit.description: A gold circuit for processor assembly.
LanguageData.Grechka_QuartzProcessor.label: quartz processor
LanguageData.Grechka_QuartzProcessor.description: A processor for the quartz signal network.
LanguageData.Grechka_SilverProcessor.label: silver processor
LanguageData.Grechka_SilverProcessor.description: A control processor for Storage devices.
LanguageData.Grechka_GoldProcessor.label: gold processor
LanguageData.Grechka_GoldProcessor.description: A computing processor for Storage devices.
LanguageData.Grechka_StorageCrafterT3_Building.label: Storage crafter T3
LanguageData.Grechka_StorageCrafterT3_Building.descri: A stationary worker for four adjacent workbenches. Runs one cycle at a time in rotation. Automatically retrieves ingredients from disks and returns products. Worker speed ×1, skill 12, power 500 W.
LanguageData.Grechka_StorageCrafterT4_Building.label: Storage crafter T4
LanguageData.Grechka_StorageCrafterT4_Building.descri: A stationary worker for four adjacent workbenches. Runs one cycle at a time in rotation. Automatically retrieves ingredients from disks and returns products. Worker speed ×3, skill 16, power 2000 W.
LanguageData.Grechka_StorageCrafterT5_Building.label: Storage crafter T5
LanguageData.Grechka_StorageCrafterT5_Building.descri: A stationary worker for four adjacent workbenches. Runs one cycle at a time in rotation. Automatically retrieves ingredients from disks and returns products. Worker speed ×8, skill 20, power 8000 W.
LanguageData.Grechka_CertusQuartz.label: certus quartz
LanguageData.Grechka_CertusQuartz.description: A resonant crystal from a meteorite. Growth sources let you grow it at home.
LanguageData.Grechka_MineableCertus.label: certus rock
LanguageData.Grechka_CertusSource.label: certus source
LanguageData.Grechka_CertusSource.description: A portable natural source with five growth stages. Grows 4 crystals in six hours, then waits for a pawn assigned to Growing to harvest them. Harvesting starts a new cycle. Each powered cardinally adjacent accelerator adds one base growth rate, up to four accelerators. Uninstall and transport the source without losing growth progress.
LanguageData.Grechka_CertusAccelerator.label: certus accelerator
LanguageData.Grechka_CertusAccelerator.description: Accelerates growth in sources directly adjacent on the four cardinal sides. Consumes 250 W.
LanguageData.Grechka_PackedStorageDevice.label: minified Storage device
LanguageData.Grechka_DiskRack.label: Storage disk rack
LanguageData.Grechka_DiskRack.description: A rack for ten removable disks. Connects to the controller with quartz cable and uses 120 W from the ordinary power grid. Protected against fire and damage, but can be stolen. Disks remain inside when moved and are removed intact when deconstructed.
LanguageData.Grechka_DataCore_1K_Item.label: memory cell 1K
LanguageData.Grechka_DataCore_1K_Item.description: An empty hardware cell for a disk of size 1K. Contains no items. Used to assemble disks and the next size of cell.
LanguageData.Grechka_Disk_1K_Item.label: storage disk 1K
LanguageData.Grechka_Disk_1K_Item.description: A removable disk with 63 item types and 1024 bytes of capacity. Preserves individual item properties. Food spoils at ambient temperature. Destroying the disk destroys its contents.
LanguageData.Grechka_FrozenDisk_1K_Item.label: freezing disk 1K
LanguageData.Grechka_FrozenDisk_1K_Item.description: A removable disk with 63 item types and 1024 bytes of capacity. Preserves individual item properties. Permanent freezing works even outside the network and in caravans. Destroying the disk destroys its contents.
